kpis.label: Total ABHA patients
kpis.description: Patients seen in this period who have an ABHA (national health ID) linked, out of 443 seen.

kpis.label: ABHA verified
kpis.description: Patients whose linked ABHA is verified. NOTE: the KYC-vs-non-KYC enrolment channel is not stored in this database (it lives in the ABDM service), so this is verification state, the nearest available proxy, not the KYC channel.

kpis.label: Linked, unverified
kpis.description: Patients with an ABHA linked but not yet verified.

kpis.label: Consent-flagged patients
kpis.description: Patients carrying the ABHA consent flag. Request-level consent success/failure (and its KYC split) is not persisted here, so this coarse patient flag is the nearest proxy.

kpis.label: Care contexts linked
kpis.description: Clinical records linked into patients' ABHA accounts (HIP linking tokens). Coarse count only: the KYC vs non-KYC split of care contexts is not stored in this database.

kpis.label: Linkage rate
kpis.description: ABHA-linked patients divided by the 443 patients who visited in the selected period.

meta.note: The KYC vs non-KYC channel, request-level consent success, and the KYC split of care contexts are not stored in this analytics database (they live only in the ABDM microservices). The cards above use the patient-level flags that ARE stored, labelled honestly as proxies.
